disposition_reason: Total arsenic in 19 retail beverages and broths (lot 1) and total plus speciated arsenic in 24 further items (lot 2) bought in Tucson, all reported in µg/L.

study.design: Convenience purchase of commercial beverages and broths from one chain supermarket; 19 items (lot 1) then 24 items (lot 2) about one month later
study.market: one chain supermarket, Tucson, Arizona, USA
study.method: Microwave digestion with HNO3; total As by ICP-MS (Agilent 7500ce); speciation by HPLC-ICP-MS (C18 column)
study.lod_text: Total As 0.1 µg/L; As(III) 0.05, As(V) 0.06, MMA(V) 0.04, DMA(V) 0.04 µg/L
study.qa: NIST SRM 1640 (natural water, certified 26.71 µg/L) returned 26.12 and 25.86 (lot 1) and 26.68 and 27.04 µg/L (lot 2)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: US EPA drinking-water standard for total arsenic

unresolved: Table 4 Total Diet Study values are quoted from FDA and are not findings.
Arsenic species were measured on single samples while totals are four-aliquot means, so species can sum above the total (authors note this).
Fat free milk SD is 0.08 in Table 3 but 0.80 in Table 4.
No DOI is printed in the PDF; the manifest DOI is used.
